project: A Computational Assessment of Social Sector Spending Across Indian States (2013-14 to 2025-26)

core_variables.name: SSE
core_variables.description: Total Social Sector Expenditure (Revenue Expenditure + Capital Outlay + Loans & Advances for Social Services)

core_variables.name: SSE_REAL
core_variables.description: Total Social Sector Expenditure in constant (2011-12) prices using GSDP deflator

core_variables.name: SSE_PC
core_variables.description: Real per capita social sector expenditure (SSE_REAL / Population)

core_variables.name: SSE_GSDP
core_variables.description: Social sector expenditure as a percentage of Gross State Domestic Product

core_variables.name: SSE_TE
core_variables.description: Social sector expenditure as a percentage of Total State Expenditure

core_variables.name: EDU
core_variables.description: Expenditure on Education, Sports, Art and Culture (Major Heads 2202-2205, 4202)

core_variables.name: HEA
core_variables.description: Expenditure on Health and Family Welfare (Major Heads 2210-2211, 4210-4211)

core_variables.name: WSH
core_variables.description: Expenditure on Water Supply, Sanitation, Housing and Urban Development (Major Heads 2215-2217, 4215-4217)

core_variables.name: SSW
core_variables.description: Expenditure on Social Security and Welfare (Major Heads 2235, 4235)

core_variables.name: NUT
core_variables.description: Expenditure on Nutrition (Major Heads 2236, 4236)

core_variables.name: SCST
core_variables.description: Expenditure on SC, ST, OBC and Minorities Welfare (Major Heads 2225, 4225)

core_variables.name: BE_ACT
core_variables.description: Budget Execution Ratio: Actual Expenditure divided by Budget Estimate (SSE_ACT / SSE_BE)

core_variables.name: SAV_EXC
core_variables.description: Savings (-) or Excess (+) over legislative grants in social sector appropriations

core_variables.name: OTR_GSDP
core_variables.description: Own Tax Revenue as % of GSDP (Measure of state fiscal effort)

core_variables.name: DEV_RR
core_variables.description: Central Transfers (Devolution + Grants-in-Aid) as % of Revenue Receipts

core_variables.name: FD_GSDP
core_variables.description: Gross Fiscal Deficit as % of GSDP

core_variables.name: DEBT_GSDP
core_variables.description: Total Outstanding Liabilities as % of GSDP

core_variables.name: IP_RR
core_variables.description: Interest Payments as % of Revenue Receipts

core_variables.name: COVID
core_variables.description: COVID shock period dummy (1 for 2020-21 and 2021-22, 0 otherwise)

core_variables.name: FC_PERIOD
core_variables.description: Finance Commission Cycle (14th FC: 2015-16 to 2019-20; 15th FC: 2020-21 to 2025-26)

core_variables.name: IS_PROVISIONAL
core_variables.description: Flag indicating if the state-year uses revised/budget estimates rather than final audited CAG accounts
